trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Nothing is left to do for this one except finish the other 54: it pops the moment the last of them lands. The game gives 15 manual slots plus an autosave and has no mission replay, so rotate slots instead of overwriting. Cheats turn off trophies and saving, which makes them a bad idea in this file. Fextralife's trophy page confirms the 55-trophy split behind this platinum. Use the in-game 100% checklist after the credits to steer cleanup, and keep the final sessions loose: GAMES.GG warns chance-dependent objectives can run past its estimate.
steps: Keep separate manual saves at the start and end of every chapter.
Finish the story, then work the 100% checklist.
Mop up the trophies the checklist does not cover.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner and an unbroken Wanted Level across three shops. One lapse and the attempt resets. No source says when partner play ends, so try it while they are with you.
trophies.guide: Retail Therapy is the reverse of Hot Together: instead of escaping, you must keep police on you. GAMES.GG says to rob three shops with your partner while the red-and-blue pursuit stays active between jobs; sitting in the red heat zone without an active Wanted Level does not count. The trophy can unlock about thirty seconds after you leave the final shop, so do not abandon a successful attempt right away. Plan three shops in a tight line, drive between them without shaking the cops, and keep your partner close. If the level drops, start a fresh run of three. Pick shops with clear lanes between them so the chase stays unbroken.
steps: Pick three shops close together.
Keep the Wanted Level active between jobs.
Wait about 30 seconds after the last shop.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Whip It Good needs 100 vehicle discoveries, and GAMES.GG's completion guide sets the 100% checklist target at scanning 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, so the trophy is the halfway point. The collectibles guide warns that vehicle scanning is a different interaction from scanning places for WAiNK, so do not expect the two counters to move together. Scan whatever you drive or pass: traffic, parked cars and your own garage all give discoveries, and stolen vehicles registered through Moses overlap with On the Spot. Keep the Progress database open to see the count rather than trusting memory. Keep the Progress database open while you drive so each new scan is logged.
steps: Scan every new vehicle you meet.
Check the discovery count in Progress.
Continue to 200 for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Gunslinger needs five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. GAMES.GG gives the control and the method: while aiming a firearm press L3 and R3 together to start Combat Focus; adrenaline extends its duration, and an assault rifle helps you chew through a clustered gang group before the bar drains. The key word is single: kills across separate activations do not add up. Find a group of gang enemies standing close, start the focus only when you can already see them, and use the rifle. Fextralife lists it as a plain combat trophy with no missable flag, so you can retry freely.
steps: Find a clustered group of gang enemies.
Aim, then press L3 and R3 together.
Drop five before the focus bar empties.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Catch Me If You Can needs a large passenger plane that is attached to a boarding bridge at VCIA, not one parked elsewhere on the airfield. GAMES.GG suggests the plane at terminals E3 and E4. Get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse toward the runway and take off. The unlock is delayed: fly about a kilometre away from the airport before it appears. Expect airport security to react, so have a plan for the Wanted Level. Do it in free-roam, after the campaign if you prefer, since no source I read ties it to a story window. Keep a manual save beforehand in case airport security gets the better of you.
steps: Go to terminals E3 or E4 at VCIA.
Board the plane at the bridge and take off.
Fly about 1 km out for the delayed unlock.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description, Kinda hot in these Rhinos, is a riddle, and I found no source that decodes it, so what follows is inference and not a verified method. Rhinos are tanks in this series, and the wording suggests a Rhino and police heat. Neither GAMES.GG nor Fextralife lists the trophy's steps, so treat any claim you read elsewhere with care until the trophy actually pops. A sensible experiment is to find a tank, take it into a Wanted Level and see what the counter or notification shows. Because the trophy is hidden on PlayStation, the game will not hint at it either. Come back to this after the main cleanup.
steps: Find a Rhino tank in free-roam.
Try it while police are chasing you.
Check whether the trophy fires, and adjust.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Sneakthief is a one-time jewelry-store job, and GAMES.GG spells out a quiet route. Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun, use it on the locked back door of a jewelry store, find the safe-code note inside and open the safe without triggering the alarm. Kicking the door sets the alarm off and fails the idea. It names Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a suitable target. Go in at a calm moment, keep your approach slow and leave through the same door. Treat the Snap Gun as the unlock: without the mission you cannot do it.
steps: Play Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs for the Snap Gun.
Pick the lock on the back door, never kick it.
Read the note and open the safe quietly.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Maximum Withdrawal is a silver for five bank-vault robberies with escapes. GAMES.GG says they unlock through the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…: follow the security van to a bank and walk in while the guard has the vault open. Bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the bags alone. Each robbery triggers a 4-star Wanted Level, so the same jobs can earn Hot Together, and you must clear the red heat zone to count as escaped. The 100% checklist wants all eight vaults, so keep going after five. Keep a car ready for the exit.
steps: Play That's Where The Money Is…
Follow the van and rob five vaults with your partner.
Escape the heat zone after each one.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: A Classic Blitz Play is a one-time armored-truck robbery with an escape. GAMES.GG's roadmap stresses what escaping means: clearing the immediate flashing search area is not enough, you must leave the red heat zone as well, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County gives cover from helicopters. The sources I read do not say where armored trucks drive, so keep an eye out for one while you travel and use whatever heavy weapon you have for the stop. Make sure you have a fast vehicle waiting and a route to the tunnel before you hit it. It overlaps with the other getaway trophies.
steps: Spot an armored truck and stop it.
Take the cash and run.
Escape the red heat zone, not just the search area.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: The Goodtime State asks you to explore all of Leonida, and the sources I read do not say what counts as an area or how many there are, so I will not give a number. GAMES.GG organises the map into Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park, and Fextralife names Mariana, Kelly, Lummox and Leonard counties. Use those as your sweep order, and rely on the map's progress display to show what remains. Exploration is also where scans, stunts, meditations and animals turn up, so treat this as the sweep that carries half the cleanup.
steps: Sweep one region at a time.
Check the exploration progress on the map.
Collect cards, scans and meditations on the way.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Pest Control needs one robbed Illegal Operation for each gang, nine gangs in all according to GAMES.GG's completion table, which also says the 100% checklist wants all 39 operations. So this trophy is just the shallow end of a much bigger list: pick the nearest operation for each gang and leave the rest for later. Fextralife has a page of gang operation locations that you can open when you are ready to plan. Each robbery brings gang enemies, so be well armed and have an exit. Note which gangs you have already hit in the Progress menu, since repeating the same gang gains nothing here.
steps: Find one operation per gang.
Rob each and escape.
Track gangs already hit in Progress.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: In The Beginning… is a hidden trophy for having a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Neither source I read says where to buy the drink or which spot qualifies, and I will not make one up. Treat it as a social-activity trophy: look for a beachfront bar or seating area at Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and stay for the view. Because it is hidden on PlayStation, the game will not help you, so test one location at a time and watch for the notification. It sits well beside other short one-offs such as the showroom smash and the bowling alley, so do them in one pass.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a bar with a view and order a cocktail.
Stay seated until the trophy fires.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Capital Offense wants you to smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The sources I read give only the official line and no showroom location or vehicle, so this is an experiment: find a showroom with a drivable car and a glass front, take the car and drive through the window. The classic style is probably the plain version of that, though no source confirms it. Do it when you can afford a Wanted Level, with an escape route planned. It is hidden on PlayStation, so there is no other hint. Pair it with other one-off crimes in the same session.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Take a car and drive through the front window.
Escape any Wanted Level.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Let's Go Bowling is a robbery of Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, and GAMES.GG gives its three valuables: a luxury watch in the southeast office, a Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the contents of the safe in the northeast hallway office. Bring Sticky Bombs for the safe, then escape the police. The guide adds that valuables you collected on an earlier visit still count if you return during a later robbery, so a failed run is not wasted. Go in prepared, take all three and leave. Keep a getaway car close to the entrance, because the escape is part of the trophy. Check the Progress menu afterwards to confirm the robbery counted.
steps: Bring Sticky Bombs to Kingpin Bowling.
Take the watch, the shotgun and the safe's contents.
Escape the police.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: Needs both Jason and Lucia at maximum Strength. No source I read says it closes, but the partner only trains beside you when you visit fitness clubs together, so train as a pair, not alone.
trophies.guide: Personal Best is hidden on PlayStation behind the line, A partnership with mass appeal, and GAMES.GG decodes it: reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia. The detail that matters is the second character. Visit fitness clubs together so the inactive partner trains alongside the one you are controlling; otherwise you will be doing the work twice. Fitness also supports other stats, but the trophy only wants Strength. Start early, because workouts take time, and check each character's stat screen to see which one lags. It is not flagged as time-limited in the sources, but one lopsided stat will hold the platinum up.
steps: Train Strength at fitness clubs.
Go as a pair so both characters gain.
Check each stat screen for maximum Strength.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Counts choices that affect your Criminal Profile, and a mission choice is gone once made because there is no replay. You cannot hard-lose the count, since robberies and fights keep adding to it, but take story choices knowingly and save before the big ones.
trophies.guide: Actions Speak Louder wants 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile, according to GAMES.GG, which also says to leave it until other jobs are done because robberies and enemy encounters feed it naturally. That means a separate grind is probably unnecessary. Check the profile stat from time to time, but do not chase it. The count is the pace; the note about choices is the risk: a story choice, made once, cannot be rewound. If you want to see different outcomes, keep separate manual saves. If you are short at the end, run a few robberies, which also close out other trophies.
steps: Play normally and watch the Criminal Profile count.
Save before story choices.
Top up with robberies if you are short.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Bad Luck, I Guess, with the line Second time's the charm, is hidden on PlayStation and the sources I read do not explain it. The wording suggests failing something once and then succeeding at the same thing, but that is inference, not a verified method, so keep it as a lead and do not plan a session around it. You are most likely to trigger it by accident: fail a mission step, a race or a robbery, and retry it. Watch the notification when you do. If it still has not appeared after the cleanup, deliberately fail and retry a short activity such as an arcade game or a quick race.
steps: Fail something short on purpose.
Retry and succeed.
Check whether the trophy fires.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The Truth Is Out There carries the line, What the hell just happened?, and neither of the pages I read explains it. The title reads like a strange or paranormal encounter, but that is a guess from the name, and I will not name a location. The best way to meet it is the way the description invites: explore widely, especially at night and off the main roads, and watch for events that do not fit the map's usual activities. It is hidden on PlayStation, so nothing will warn you. Leave it for the exploration sweep and come back with a targeted search only if it is the last trophy missing.
steps: Explore off the main roads and at night.
Investigate odd map events.
Check the trophy list when something strange happens.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ten Pin means to bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by, and the official line is the only description I found. The pieces are clear enough: drive past a target and hit them with a melee weapon from the vehicle. The sources do not say where to do it or what counts as bowled over, so find a pedestrian or enemy standing near a road, pass at moderate speed and swing. A bike or an open-top car makes it easier. Keep an eye out for a Wanted Level, because hitting civilians draws police. It is hidden on PlayStation and can be retried at will.
steps: Equip a melee weapon.
Drive past a target in an open vehicle.
Swing from the vehicle and knock them down.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Dime on the Dollar asks for $250,000 earned by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. The sources I read do not describe the laundering system itself, so I cannot say which contacts take the bills or at what rate, and I will not invent one. What you can do is read the contact's screen for the earn total and watch it climb. Marked Bills come from robberies, so this trophy follows naturally from Maximum Withdrawal, Pest Control and the armored truck, and doing those first gives you the supply. Plan it as a background goal during the heist phase. Keep an eye on how much you have already earned so you know when to stop.
steps: Rob targets that yield Marked Bills.
Launder them through your contacts.
Watch the earned total reach $250,000.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Treat Yo Self wants $100,000 spent across all shops. GAMES.GG's advice is the useful warning: reserve $160,000 for the garage purchases before you spend freely on hairstyles, clothes or tattoos. Garage money and shop money are separate goals, so spend on the garages first and let clothes and cosmetics fill the rest. The sources do not say whether money paid to the real-estate app counts as a shop; check the trophy tracker to see which purchases move it. Robberies fund this naturally, so do it mid-cleanup. Compare your total spent in the menu against $100,000 occasionally. Shops cover clothing, tattoos and hairstyles, so a single splurge may finish most of it.
steps: Reserve cash for garages first.
Spend the remainder in shops.
Watch the spend total as you buy.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Little Boxes needs all the purchasable garage properties, and GAMES.GG is exact: eight garages count, they cost $160,000 together, and the four story garages do not need buying. Purchases open through the Vice City Real Estate phone app after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Save the money before you spend freely on cosmetics. More parking also supports On the Spot, because you need room to register ten vehicles. Order does not matter, so buy the cheapest first as soon as you can afford them. Check the app's list for ones you have not bought. It is the easiest property trophy in the list once the money is in hand, so do it as soon as cash allows. Keep a note of which you own.
steps: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2.
Open the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all eight garages.

sources.label: GAMES.GG: GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: On the Spot needs ten vehicles registered through the Scooter Bros app. GAMES.GG says the app unlocks through the Chapter 2 mission Moses: steal eligible vehicles, take them to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and then Register. Cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down. At first Moses accepts only vehicles without trackers; later Chapter 3 progress allows Standard Tracker vehicles and registration at Pay 'n' Spray locations. You also need parking room for the cars, so Little Boxes helps. Steal ten of the same cheap model if you can, and register them in a batch. Keep a note of which bikes and cars you have already registered so you do not repeat one.
steps: Finish Moses in Chapter 2.
Steal cheap, tracker-free vehicles.
Respray and register ten at Moses.
